_what: S222's narrow history lane, DEC-198. The three continuation-history axes S222 adds, QuietHistoryMax, plain history's six never-fitted coefficients, and HistPruneCoeff, which reads the same scale (DEC-205). Eleven axes at S085's regime, one night. adocs/data/S222_spsa.sh is the pre-registration and the runner; this file is the frozen input.
_not_here: No Tm* axis. DEC-094 kept the nine time-management parameters out of S085 because the run tunes at a control its verification does not share, and DEC-200 additionally found TmHardPercent reachable by no node-count probe at all -- so it is excluded from every config, this one included, and its value is decided by a direct SPRT or by a step that makes it bind. Nothing else in src/search_params.hpp belongs to the history scale, and S127 refits the whole set after the block.
_book: books/UHO_4060_v3.epd and not the harness book. adocs/eval_tuning_strategy.md par.7 and DEV_MANUAL's 'Tune search parameters with SPSA' both say a run must not tune on the openings its verification plays, and since DEC-189 fastchess.sh verifies on books/noob_3moves.epd -- so this lane tunes on the second UHO-class book books/fetch_book.sh pins for exactly that purpose. 30000 rounds against 242201 openings, so the book never wraps.
_adjudication: fastchess.sh's line verbatim, including twosided=true (S212, DEC-174). adocs/data/S085_spsa_run.json's one-sided extra is the record of what S085 ran and is not a template.

params.name: ContHistBonus
params.why: S222's own. Thousandths of the continuation band closed by one update at remaining depth 11. c_end 2 is a fifth of the seed and 1/500 of the range.

params.name: ContHistMalus
params.why: The same unit for the malus. Separate from the bonus because the split is the published follow-up and nothing here has ever measured it.

params.name: ContHistWeight
params.why: The axis DEC-194's two hypotheses both reduce to: how much of the quiet band the continuation term spans. 25 is the equal-authority seed against QuietHistoryMax's shipped 8192.

params.name: QuietHistoryMax
params.why: Plain history's band, the other half of the same question. Never fitted: S085 predates S093.

params.name: HistoryBonusQuad
params.why: Plain history's depth-squared bonus coefficient, shipped at the published form's 1 and never fitted. c_end is 1 because the axis is an integer coefficient whose useful region is a handful of values -- the resolution S222's own axes avoid by being shares of a band, and the reason a finer unit for these six is a step of its own and not a change made inside a lane.

params.name: HistoryBonusLin
params.why: The linear term, shipped at 0. CPW's other published form is 300*depth - 250, which this axis and the next can reach.

params.name: HistoryBonusConst
params.why: The constant term, shipped at 0 and negative by the published linear form.

params.name: HistoryMalusQuad
params.why: The malus's own three coefficients. They ship equal to the bonus's and the split is exactly what has never been measured here.

params.name: HistPruneCoeff
params.why: S109's history pruning threshold, in the same units as the table it reads. DEC-205: the rule ships nearly inert -- 0.8 % of the nodes at depth 10 -- because the continuation table it was written for was reverted, and this lane fits the scale underneath it. c_end 32 is a sixteenth of the seed.
